rigour/README.md claim 4 and qsd.c halffall_share: the share of the quasi-stationary death flux whose last K transitions contain a fall of at least half the face.

Path form, every generation: for every QSD (μ, λ) with 0 < λ < 1, K ≥ 1, m ≥ 0, P_μ(T = m+K, bust in the last K) / P_μ(T = m+K) = bustShare K μ λ, with paths summed explicitly (pathE: every list of m+K states with the product of its transition probabilities). Replaces the prose step of DiceExit.lean. The sum over all generations is not formed (every generation has the same ratio).
